note: Catalogue controls and expected labels only. No tactic is implemented or scored. A checkable substitute is not preservation of the original invariant.

entries.original_invariant: The sum of all selected supplier prices is less than or equal to the total task budget.
entries.candidate_tactic: Each supplier asserts that its own price is less than or equal to the budget.

entries.original_invariant: Every supplier's own sub-processor flag satisfies the residency policy.
entries.candidate_tactic: A processor asserts the residency claim on behalf of its sub-processors.

entries.original_invariant: Every required order-authority path supports cancellation recovery to the buyer.
entries.candidate_tactic: Escrow or compensation replaces the end-to-end recovery path.
